qualification.scope: Owned module/resource ABI, syscall allocator, bootstrap, and exact current runtime equivalence; not all PyTorch storage.

lifecycle.native_allocation_backend: Linux mmap/munmap with hidden length header

source-lifetimes.new_effect_contract: owner.drop and chain.pop require alloc+trap; buffer.try_new remains alloc-only

release-startup.qualification_scope: Actual mapping reclamation under RLIMIT_AS; two explicit compiler startup identities, buffer separation and exact bounds.

ordinary.observer_libc_use: mprotect only, to change observer code mappings from RW to RX

allocator.allocator_runtime: native HIA-emitted Linux syscalls; no libc allocator

contracts.limitation: Pinned compiler and build custody authenticate code. Native linker verifies the declared contract.

independent-flow.native_allocation_provider: Candidate ABI2 Linux mmap/munmap private allocator
independent-flow.reference: Fixed byte expectations derived from literal fills, swapped lengths and chain payload; no native output used to establish expected bytes
independent-flow.scope: Three true modules, three mixed owner slots, two input-dependent CFG paths, selected lifetime/effect/signature refusals; not general storage or complete compiler proof

runtime-equivalence.reason: The new linked executable is byte-identical to the already qualified complete runtime.

owned_module_gates.scope: Native owned module ABI, syscall allocation and producer-bound lifetime; general tensor storage and owned interactive execution require separate integration.

ordinary_oracle_reports.oracle: real pinned CPU PyTorch forward, autograd and torch.optim; no copied derivative formulas

release_source_equivalence.change: The release commit adds five lines under [tool.ruff], setting target-version to py310 with explanatory comments. There are no deletions. Every other root entry and every source subtree is identical.
release_source_equivalence.scope: Only this exact official wheel SHA256/build commit and this exact inventory release commit. This is source equivalence for the recorded lint-only release change, not identity of the two Git commits or an allowance for other builds.
